description: Audio file browser and player: it streams WAV, FLAC and MP3 from disk, previews them with trim points and looping, and drags a sample onto a sampler module.

params.text: Sets the level of the preview, from silence to plus 6dB.
Starts playback as soon as a file is clicked in the browser; shift-clicking a file plays it whatever this is set to.

outputs.text: The left channel of the file being previewed.
The right channel of the file being previewed.

notes: the space bar starts and stops playback, and dragging a file onto a sampler module loads it there; a set trim region drops only that part of the file.
the browser is empty until a folder is added: click the source button at the top and choose Add root.
menu: Resample on playback — converts the file to Rack's sample rate as it plays; Resample on drop converts the file handed to another module, and Resample quality is Fast, Default or Best.
Folder for converted/trimmed files — Same folder as source file, a Custom folder, or Patch storage so the files travel with the patch; Always copy copies even when no conversion is needed.
Index metadata for all files — on the source button's own menu, reading duration, sample rate, bit depth, channels and BPM for every file under the current source, which the filters read.
Suggest tags on all files — on the source button's own menu, analysing each file and proposing tags from a fixed vocabulary.
Convert to WAV on drop — writes a WAV copy of the file handed to another module, whatever format it was read from.
Add root... and Remove current root — on the source button's own menu, adding or removing a folder the browser reads from.
